# Dale Whitfield — Regional Director

- **Relationship:** Marc's skip-up — [Renata Vasquez](../people/renata-vasquez.md)'s boss. Runs ~5 districts.
- **Cadence:** no direct 1:1 with Marc; shows up on quarterly regional store walks and the occasional
  district call. Last store walk at #4172 was in **April 2026**.
- **What he cares about:** regional P&L — comp sales, shrink, and payroll-as-%-of-sales. He set the FY26
  regional shrink push that's putting pressure on Renata.
- **How to work with him:** extremely brief, extremely prepared. When he's in the store he'll pull an
  associate at random and ask what's on the endcap and why — floor execution has to be tight.
- **Sensitivities:** does not like hearing about a store problem for the first time from someone other than
  the SM. Bad news travels to him fast; Marc should never let Dale learn something from LP or HR that Marc
  could have told Renata first.
